title: Tree Families — Eden, Kabbalah, Yggdrasil, Bodhi, Vine, Mustard and Root of Jesse
purpose: Map recurring sacred Tree forms by structural function rather than treating every world tree, enlightenment tree, lineage tree and branching metaphor as the same hidden object.
master_rule: First identify what the Tree does in its source tradition: life-access, knowledge-boundary, cosmic connection, enlightenment site, covenant lineage, community-vine, small-seed expansion or branching emanation. Compare functions only after that.

families.distinction: Not identical with the Kabbalistic sefirotic Tree.

functions: knowledge of good and evil narrative
families.distinction: Genesis does not contain the later Qliphoth Tree.

families.tradition: Jewish Kabbalah and later diagram traditions
families.distinction: Not generic botany or the Genesis Tree of Life.
World Tree ecology is the key comparison, not a one-to-one Tree of Life equation.

families.tradition: Buddhist life of the Buddha / pilgrimage
functions: stable place of meditative confrontation and insight
families.distinction: Bodhi Tree is not a cosmic world-axis by default; its primary significance is enlightenment site.

functions: organic relation of branches to living source
families.distinction: Vine is a relational organism with branches; not the same growth architecture as a trunked world tree.

functions: small beginning → disproportionate visible growth / shelter imagery
families.distinction: Seed-to-growth parable, not a botanical equation for the Potato.
Root here is genealogical/dynastic before it is cosmic Axis.

project_synthesis.axis: orientation reference passing through tree layers but not identical with organism
project_synthesis.pruning: regulated removal that can improve or damage depending function
project_synthesis.root_paradox: causal/source origin and spatial root deployment are different relations; 'root above' can be theological genealogy while literal botanical roots grow downward.

conversation_genealogy: 2026-02-25: Yggdrasil, Bodhi, mustard, vine, roots, seed and fruit already coexisted in project vocabulary.
2026-06-06: roots in humanity / sprout in heaven; Tree of Life and Tree of Strife fork explicitly stated.
2026-08-31: Yggdrasil retained as structural parallel with roots/wells/maintenance rather than identity.
2026-09-18: Tree branching/pruning mechanics formalized as regulated differentiation.
